name: Dovin Baan
title: Azorius Grand Arbiter
role: Bolas-aligned administrator of the Azorius Senate
summary: The planeswalker who used Ravnica's legal institutions to obstruct opposition to Bolas.
biography: Dovin Baan was a Vedalken planeswalker known for his administrative precision and talent for finding flaws in systems.
He came to Ravnica and gained control of the Azorius Senate, using civic authority in ways that strengthened Bolas's conspiracy and obstructed its opponents.
His political control demonstrates why the War of the Spark was not only a magical battle: the city's own institutions had been compromised. Following the war, Vraska was asked to pursue him.

Dovin's perspective was shaped by an ability to notice flaws in organizations and mechanisms. On Ravnica he applied this aptitude to a government whose legitimacy rested on procedure and regulation. It was an environment in which a seemingly technical decision could have consequences for the defense of an entire city.

His alignment with Nicol Bolas turned bureaucratic power into a strategic resource. The Azorius Senate did not have to be defeated in open combat before it could be used to obstruct cooperation or authorize harmful measures. That form of control complemented the magical trap and invasion forces waiting outside ordinary civic life.

The aftermath exposed a different kind of responsibility from the battlefield decisions made by Gideon or Liliana. Officials who had wielded legal authority for an invading conspiracy left behind a problem of trust, accountability, and succession. Dovin's actions belong to that institutional history, not merely to a list of enemy planeswalkers.
